title: salvia subbipinnata
intro: Salvia subbipinnata, commonly known as the narrow-leafed sage, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of cognitive function, as well as its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress. Therapeutic actions of Salvia subbipinnata include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
